author: Hannah Fry
title: A big day for my channel!

author: Hannah Fry
description:
I built an AI agent. She opened a shop selling novelty mugs, emailed a journalist without being asked, and then leaked our passwords to a total stranger. 

AI agents don't just answer questions - they act. They can browse the web, send emails, and spend your money. Anyone can build one. So my friend Brendan and I did.

We gave it a bank card and a few weeks to show us what it could do. 

The mugs she designed can be bought here. https://www.teepublic.com/user/cassandralabmugs
Although frankly why you’d actually want one is beyond me.


CREDITS

Brendan Maginnis is the CEO and Founder of Sourcery AI.

Nicklas Berild Lundblad is a Senior Fellow at the TUM Think Tank in Munich and founder of Pharos Futures Research Group, a company focused on combining AI and foresight. He previously spent 15 years at Google, including three as Head of Public Policy at Google DeepMind.
title: Why AI Agents are either the best or worst thing we’ve ever built
